title.narrative: Holistic Lifesaving Nutrition Assistance in Mafa LGA

description.narrative: ltpgtThis proposal, developed in alignment with the NHF 2025 First Standard Allocation – Lean Season Strategy, presents a timely, people-centered response to the urgent Nutrition needs of vulnerable populations in Mafa LGA, Borno State, classified as a high-severity and underserved area. FHI 360 will target children under five and women of reproductive age, who are most at risk due to ongoing conflict, displacement, flooding, and weakened health systems.ltbrgtFHI 360 will restore access to therapeutic nutrition services by reopening the non-functional Stabilization Centre (SC) at Mafa General Hospital. The SC will offer inpatient management of Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) with medical complications in children aged 0–59 months, in line with national IMAM protocols.ltbrgtThe SC will receive referrals for Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) cases with medical complications from partners providing OTP services in the accessible wards of Mafa LGA including include AHSF, BoSPHCDB, EYN, GREENCODE, and Save the Children. To ensure seamless two-way referrals, referral linkages with these partners will be re-established and strengthened. This will facilitate timely and coordinated management of SAM cases across the continuum of care. ltbrgtFHI 360 will provide cash for transport based on the Northeast CVA for Nutrition guidelines and three square balanced nutritious meal for caretakers and their children to promote adherence to treatment regimen, along with structured maternal, infant and young child feeding nutrition (MIYCN) counselling throughout the admission period. Routine mortality audits will be conducted to ensure compliance with Sphere standards and guide continuous quality improvement in clinical care.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtTo promote sustained behavior change, community-based support groups will be formed to facilitate Social and Behavior Change Communication (SBCC) on MIYCN.lt/spangtlt/pgt
